content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Palmdale

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your educational background, then gather evidence of your project leadership roles. Palmdale's aerospace, defense, and public-sector employers often employ PMP-credentialed managers; confirm you meet baseline criteria before investing in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend synchronous classes from your location at a schedule that fits your work calendar. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and exam-focused content across five intensive days, preparing you to apply for PMI certification.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, complete your formal PMP application through PMI's website. Document your project experience, upload required certificates, and pay the associated PMI exam fee. Granite PM Academy staff can answer questions about the application process and what PMI expects from Palmdale professionals.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your computerized PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify complex topics and help you master the competencies PMI assesses.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and industry engagement. Palmdale's project-heavy sectors—aerospace, construction, and public administration—offer abundant opportunities to grow your expertise while satisfying PMI renewal requirements.
